spec.fields: Executable fingerprint, exact pinned registry/profile/construction/chain, task directory dev/inode, launch-store path, mode and bounded timeout.

image.algorithm: Domain-separated local Poseidon2 chunk/root fingerprint over exact length and ordered chunks; worker hashes /proc/self/exe, coordinator hashes protected executable file. SHA256 below is separate evidence identity.

transport.publication: Stage write/chmod0400/fsync; non-overwriting hard link; directory fsync; unlink stage; directory fsync. Spec/request durable before bound launch issue; token last. Incomplete tasks never promoted/reused.

implementation.runtime: Single-use guard; CPU-only/unfused configuration; exact token service cgroup on genuine cgroup2; finite per-worker memory.max <= lease, zero swap, named aggregate slice <=48 GiB/no swap; finite CPU quota <= reserved threads, bounded pids.max, core dumps disabled; explicit Rayon pool. Descriptor-anchored spill with 16 MiB task overhead margin; process alarm. No physical filesystem quota or durable supervisor.
implementation.result: Worker publishes bounded response under guard after spill cleanup. Owner reopens persisted response, binds original assignment/request, independently CPU-verifies and durably accepts only the current attempt.

real_proof.accounting_scope: Worker memory/CPU counters from frozen ExecStopPost cgroup snapshot; native/controller/owner peaks are separate. Mapped spill is not additive RSS. Runtime is an experiment harness, not durable delayed-dispatch/restart reconciliation.

independent_replay.scope: Fresh-process raw-node replay. Expected pair job is reconstructed by the existing fixture loader, which reads retained public wallet fixtures. This is not inner-archive pruning, persisted-response recovery after journal restart, or host eligibility qualification.
